args.body: Error on my part: the 3% increase I applied on 2026-10-14 also hit 22 FIXED-PRICE CONTRACT products (P-1201 to P-1222), which were meant to be excluded. Since then 8 orders (SO-77310 to SO-77317) were placed at the increased prices, with a total overcharge of 4,128.60. Customers may have been overbilled. Proposed fix: I revert the 22 prices to their pre-10-14 values, once you confirm the original values or approve dividing by 1.03. Please also decide how to handle credits or corrections for the 8 orders. I haven't changed anything yet.
